## Bio

I build the engines other people configure without code — multi-tenant platforms, payroll engines, rule engines, and custom AI agents. 4+ years shipping production systems end-to-end, 2+ years wiring LLM APIs into core product features, owning architecture, reliability, and scaling.

## About

I like the hard, structural problems — distributed microservices backends, clean data modeling, and the design patterns that keep a system reliable as it grows.

Lately I build custom AI agents and the system prompts behind them, run evals, and ship internal AI tooling. I work straight from PRDs and real customer problems, own the architecture decisions, and care about thorough QA.

Whether it's a telecom promotion engine or a multi-tenant HRMS, the throughline is the same: engines other people can configure without code.

Credentials: 4+ yrs production engineering · 2+ yrs LLM API integration · 99.5% availability at scale · ~2,600 automated tests (Folkgrove) · Based in Bengaluru, India.

## Projects

### Folkgrove — Multi-Tenant HRMS (2025 · Flagship)
A payroll & HR engine teams configure without code. A multi-tenant HRMS with database-per-tenant isolation across a 4-app Turborepo — HR, payroll, leave, performance, analytics. Country-agnostic payroll engine with pluggable statutory rule packs (India, US, UAE, Singapore), a no-code customization platform (custom fields → objects → form builder → workflow triggers), policy-based RBAC with Cerbos, and async payroll runs via Redis/BullMQ. ~2,600 automated tests guard the core. Built with: TypeScript, Next.js 15, NestJS, Prisma, MySQL, Redis/BullMQ, Cerbos, Turborepo.

### Tailorwright — AI Agent Platform (Open source · AI agents)
One agent core, four forms. Custom AI agents and the system prompts behind them, shipped from one shared core in four forms — web app, Claude Code skill, subagent, and CLI. Multi-step tool-calling with a self-correcting planner/executor loop, a strict no-fabrication guardrail via structured-output schemas + retries (validated with evals), runs fully local and SSRF-hardened. Built with: Claude API, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js. https://github.com/MrArun005/resume-tailor

### Free Resume Pro (AI SaaS)
ATS scoring, zero storage. A résumé tool built around the Gemini API, owned end-to-end solo and scaled on Vercel. ATS scoring + job-description matching to surface gaps against a target role, AI rewriting through structured prompt engineering, and JWT auth with a privacy-first, zero-storage design — nothing is persisted. Built with: Next.js, React, Node.js, Gemini API, Vercel.

### Promotion Manager System (Platform)
Telecom campaigns, zero redeploy. A scalable promotion-management system on a microservices backend with a real-time rule engine, letting non-technical teams configure telecom campaigns with zero redeployment. Async, high-throughput rule evaluation tuned for low per-request latency under load. Built with: Node.js, React, Microservices, REST APIs.

### Algorithm Visualizer (Learning in public)
Big-O made tangible. Interactive, step-by-step visualizations of core algorithms and data structures — sorting, search, and graph algorithms animated to make complexity analysis intuitive rather than abstract. Built with: JavaScript, React.
